faq_heading: Homes near Serpentine Heights Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Serpentine Heights Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Serpentine Heights Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Serpentine Heights Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Serpentine Heights Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 49 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,235,000, townhomes $817,450. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Serpentine Heights Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Serpentine Heights Elementary the median was 35 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 49 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Serpentine Heights Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are North Surrey Secondary (0.6 km north-west), Surrey Christian School (0.9 km south) and Woodland Park Elementary (1.0 km south-west).

Serpentine Heights Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 16126 93a Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Serpentine Heights Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Serpentine Heights Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Serpentine Heights Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Serpentine Heights Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 49 homes sold within 1 km of Serpentine Heights Elementary: 25 houses and 22 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,235,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Serpentine Heights Elementary

22 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Serpentine Heights Elementary in a straight line (15 elementary, 4 secondary, 3 other; 5 independent). The closest is North Surrey Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is William Watson Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Woodland Park Elementary (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is Surrey Christian School (0.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Woodland Park Elementary (1.0 km south-west), St Matthew's Elementary (1.0 km south), Berkshire Park Elementary (1.5 km west), Frost Road Elementary (1.6 km south), William F. Davidson Elementary (1.6 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Woodland Park Elementary, 1.0 km south-west of Serpentine Heights Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Serpentine Heights Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Serpentine Heights Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Serpentine Heights Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Serpentine Heights Elementary was $1,235,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Woodland Park Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.0 km south-west of Serpentine Heights Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
